fieldValues.title: Use authored Field names as Record value keys
fieldValues.decision_rationale: Record instances and projected schemas need one legible value shape. Version-pinned Types make authored Field names stable enough to key values, avoiding a permanent UUID-key bridge or a target-specific name transform.
fieldValues.decision_statement: The revision-2 Record carrier will store fieldValues as an object keyed verbatim by Field.name, with field identity recovered through the Record's version-pinned Type rather than repeated as a fieldId in each value.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
- Keep the UUID-keyed FieldValue array.
- Key the object by field UUID.
- Transform authored names to lowerCamelCase.
- Add a separate fieldId map to each Type.
fieldValues.accepted_costs: Readable keys become load-bearing within a pinned Type version; stored write order and per-entry UUID redundancy disappear, and the ecosystem requires an atomic migration.
fieldValues.review_trigger: Review when Field-name mutation, Type-version pinning, or a new carrier format would make verbatim authored keys ambiguous or unsafe.
